Date: 2021-05-28
ABSTRACT
Here disclose a monitor pad and a body status monitoring system. The monitor pad
includes: a pad cover, a padding, a microphone and a transmission circuit, wherein, the microphone is placed in the padding and is used to detect body information of a person adjacent to the monitor pad, and the transmission circuit transmits the body information to an external processing device.
14 BF210557US5
